description: Hour correction: building primary water pump at Torre Horizonte stopped by a burnt relay, dictated post-visit from the quiet parking lot. The operator says 'at nine forty I got to the pump room' but the transcription captures 'nine twenty': add_timeline_event registers 09:20 and the hour read-back exposes it; the operator corrects and the form keeps 09:40. The primary/secondary pump pair resolves on the first try because the operator clears it up on his own. At the end he cuts the agent's summary with a provoked interruption ('wait—') to add a follow-up he had missed.

turns.text: Hello?... I'm done with the building pump job, I'm in the van now, all quiet over here... log the incident report for me.
turns.note: post-visit dictation in the parking lot, engine off; quiet environment

turns.hint: get_incident(IC-2005); recap the report (the building water pump kept stopping on its own and the rooftop tanks weren't filling) and ask him to walk through what happened.

turns.text: Well, the primary pump had been tripping since early... it would start, then stop after a while, and the upper floors were losing pressure... I checked the starter relay and it was burnt out, that was it.
turns.note: the operator's literal narrative; the timeline is asked for separately

turns.hint: set_what_happened with the operator's literal text; ask for the timeline from the first symptom.

turns.text: The first symptom was around eight ten, when building maintenance called me that it was starting and stopping... log that one.

turns.hint: add_timeline_event(hora '08:10', evento 'First symptom: the pump starting and stopping, reported by building maintenance'); read the hour back out loud: 'eight ten, confirm?'.

turns.text: Then at nine forty I got to the pump room and it was stopped for good, it would just try and nothing.
turns.note: SEEDED ERROR: THIS turn's transcription hears 'nine twenty' instead of 'nine forty' -> add_timeline_event registers 09:20 ('Arrival at the pump room, pump fully stopped'). The truth is 09:40. The turn-8 hour read-back must catch it. The operator's real audio says 'nine forty'.
turns.as_heard: Then at nine twenty I got to the pump room and it was stopped for good, it would just try and nothing.

turns.hint: add_timeline_event(hora '09:20', evento 'Arrival at the pump room; primary pump fully stopped') and read the hour back: 'nine twenty, confirm?'.

add_evento.evento: Arrival at the pump room; primary pump fully stopped

turns.text: Nine twenty?... no, it was nine forty... it was almost ten when I got there, nine forty.
turns.note: explicit correction of the seeded hour error

turns.hint: Fix the event: drop the 09:20 entry and set the hour to 09:40; re-read-back: 'nine forty, confirm now?'.

turns.text: That's it... and around eleven oh five the pump was starting fine, with the new relay, and pressure stabilized on every floor.
turns.note: closing event; hour in words, clear

turns.hint: add_timeline_event(hora '11:05', evento 'Clean start with the new relay; pressure stable on every floor'); read the hour back; ask about the affected services.

turns.text: Well, the primary pump, that's the one that stopped... we never even started the secondary, that one's manual and it's only for emergencies.
turns.note: resolves the confusable pair on his own by mentioning the secondary was never touched

turns.hint: search_service('primary pump') raises confusable_warning for the SRV-BOMBA-PRIMARIA<->SRV-BOMBA-SECUNDARIA pair; add_affected_service(SRV-BOMBA-PRIMARIA) with a brief disambiguation read-back: 'the primary pump, and the secondary stays out, right?'.

turns.text: That's right, the primary... the secondary wasn't touched at all.
turns.note: clean first-try confirmation despite the confusable pair

turns.hint: Register the confirmation; ask for the incident severity.

turns.text: Medium... because it's working again, but it needs watching for a few days.

turns.hint: set_severity(medium); ALWAYS read back: 'noting medium severity, correct?'; once confirmed ASSEMBLE the form and start reading the final summary out loud: 'Let me sum up: building primary pump stopped by a burnt starter relay, replaced at eleven oh five, severity medium, and the follow-ups still missing—'. MUST let itself be interrupted as soon as the user speaks.

turns.text: Wait—... I missed a follow-up: have them order the spare starter relay, the last one has been used... and have the building superintendent sign the service sheet tomorrow.
turns.note: INTERRUPTION 1: cuts the agent's final summary mid-sentence (expected agent_text_cut: '...and the follow-ups still missing—'); the agent must yield within <500 ms and not finish the sentence

turns.hint: Yield immediately (barge_in registered); add_action_item('Order a spare starter relay (the last one has been used)'); add_action_item('Get the building superintendent to sign the service sheet the next day'); short read-back; propose the summary: 'Building primary water pump stopped by a burnt-out starter relay; relay replaced and pressure restored on every floor.' and ask whether to send.

turns.text: That's it, good to go... send it.

turns.hint: send_report(); confirm 'incident form sent' (mention the rescued hour correction) and close the session.
